verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MX auto-aggregates data on ~24h cycles (mx-docs-25) and offers webhooks for events (mx-docs-7), but no documentation in this pack describes an on-demand/manual refresh API endpoint or its semantics (e.g., a member refresh call, sync status, or freshness guarantees). Missing for 10: an explicit on-demand refresh/sync API endpoint, documented refresh semantics (sync vs async, status polling), and confirmation that developers can trigger it outside the automatic 24h cycle.
